segments.text:
V. 9.
Tell the viſion to no man—Not to the reſt of the Diſciples, leſt they ſhould be grieved and diſcouraged becauſe they were not admitted to the Sight; nor to any other Perſons, leſt it ſhould enrage ſome the more, and his approaching Sufferings ſhould make others diſbelieve it; till the Son of man be riſen again—Till the Reſurrection ſhould make it credible, and confirm their Teſtimony about it.
